title: Iris
description: Nine black anodised aperture blades over a club ceiling of bulbs. Turn the ring from f/1.4 to f/16 and the lights fall from nine-sided bokeh discs into 18-point stars while the scene sharpens and the exposure keeps up.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: a real nine-blade iris whose opening is the shape of every bokeh disc and the source of every diffraction spike in the photo behind it.
